description: This file defines the React component 'BlocksEditor', which is a rich text editor built on the Lexical framework, incorporating various plugins and custom logic for editing, handling state changes, and rendering.

classes.name: BlocksEditor
classes.description: React functional component implementing a rich text editor using Lexical and various plugins, with customizable properties.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Callback to handle editor state changes, optionally ignoring the first change, and invoking a user-provided onChange callback with updated content.

methods.name: onRef
methods.description: Function to set and manage reference to the floating anchor element used by plugins.
